comment: Index order is not panel order in the last knob row and the last jack row: the enum runs DRV then INV while the widget places INV on the left and DRV on the right, and the same swap applies to their two jacks (src/F.cpp:223-231). The tags are written from the widget. The four prototypes in the table are commented BW2, BW4, BE4 and L4, meaning Butterworth, Bessel and Legendre (src/F.cpp:58-69); the naming in the two morph lines follows the maker's README, which is the manual, and the code comments do not name the Linkwitz pair, so that pairing is the maker's word rather than something the source states. The filter is two two pole sections in series, each morphed independently. None of the five morph controls is clamped after its CV is added, so a large voltage carries the morph past the ends of the knob's travel. The panel prints SPD, SKW, FRQ, LAH, INV, DRV, the six modulation jacks, IN and OUT.
